signed_source: clip(efficiency_signed + 0.15 * ngs_st_signed) using week3-split-efficiency.jsonl and week3-ngs-st-pace.jsonl
rationale: Opponent-adjusted blend. A second CPOE is the same family. The signed value is this game only.

grain: charted motion, play-action, RPO, and shotgun rates
signed_source: clip(home-minus-away mean of motion, play_action, rpo, shotgun + 0.15 * drive_start helper)
rationale: Drive-start is the helper, capped at 0.15. Not the MOVE-37 sin formula.
Outs are availability. Questionable skill players stay on airwave.

signed_source: clip(rest_diff * 0.4108 / 14). Slope and se are environment-calibration.json rest_days_to_margin, n=544.
rationale: Rest cleared |slope| > se on margin. The signed value is this game's rest difference.
2025 walk-forward r=0.241, n=250. Tackle-out drag is not a second trench part.

grain: quarterback versus the weeks 1-2 snap leader
rationale: Same quarterback is a real zero. Zero stays in the sum.
